subject: inorganic
question:
无机化学·配位化学：请判断下列配合物的几何构型：Schrock alkylidyne（W(≡Ct-Bu)(Ot-Bu)₃）？
A. Tetrahedral
B. Square planar
C. Linear
D. Square pyramidal
explanation: Tetrahedral. Covalent count: W (group 6) 6 e; 1 × ≡Ct-Bu (X₃) 3 e; 3 × Ot-Bu (X) 3 e: 12 e. Ionic count: the ligands carry a charge of −6 in all and the complex is neutral, so the metal is W(VI), d⁰; d⁰ + 12 e from the ligands = 12 e. An alkyne-metathesis catalyst. The alkylidyne is X3.
